method: Each section read in full by a machine-assisted reviewer against the packs and the ground catalogue as of this date; not a legal review.

sections.bearsOn: States that the implementation policy guides the order's application and is not legally binding.
Defines the CFLB, the denominator of objective A: forested provincial Crown land, excluding private, federal, municipal land and woodlots.
sections.gapNote: Code builds a CFLB proxy (or takes a stated CFLB and scales by it).

sections.bearsOn: Defines licensee as a party preparing an FDP or FSP.
Defines mBECs as groupings of BEC units shown on Map #2.
Defines NDUs by reference to DeLong (2002), Map #1.
Defines NFAs as unharvested beetle-affected stands (old, dying, dead or young natural) used as a surrogate for old forest.
sections.gapNote: Decision 3: a beetle-killed stand keeps its VRI age and counts as old until harvested.

sections.bearsOn: Old is >140 years, except >120 years in all Moist Interior - Plateau variants, Omineca Valley SBSdk, SBSdw3, BWBSdk1, SBSmc2, SBSmk1 and McGregor Plateau SBSmk1 and SBSmh; the ICH is left undecided.
sections.gapNote: oldAgeRule (units.ts) implements it, using 140 for the ICH as the LLOWG and the Board did; its ages match the 2022 letter's Appendix 2 for every unit.

sections.bearsOn: Old interior forest is old forest or NFA buffered from younger stands: 200 m from pine/deciduous-leading NSR or age class 1-3 and from other species NSR or age class 1-4, 0 m from older classes if the area is over 200 m wide.
Young forest, for objective C, is forest 0-20 years old.
NFAs may stand in for live old forest; an affected licensee keeps a representative portion either in proportion to the unaffected area (a) or by following the non-pine minimums of Tables 8-10 (b).
sections.gapNote: Non-pine minimums are computed; option (a) is shown as figures in the D.3 representation summary without a judgement.

sections.bearsOn: Minimum percent of CFLB retained as old non-pine-leading forest for D1-D7 (2-16%).
sections.gapNote: nonPineLeadingOldMinPctOfCflb in the order JSON; values match.

sections.bearsOn: Minimum percent of CFLB retained as old non-pine-leading forest for E1-E5 (4-33%).
Minimum percent of CFLB retained as old non-pine-leading forest for A5-A13 (1-28%).
The ministry may require spatially located old forest retention areas where values are at risk or aspatial management fails; this is the basis the 2022 letter used for COFAs.
sections.gapNote: Nothing to test on its own; its outcome (COFAs) is the block-level gap recorded under pgtsa-loe.

sections.bearsOn: Interior old forest is to be managed over time, and the near-term strategy is expected to minimize fragmentation of mid-aged (60-100 year) forest.
sections.gapNote: Interior is projected over the plan's periods; nothing measures fragmentation of 60-100 year forest a block causes.

sections.bearsOn: Replaces the original 200 m buffer against all stands under old age with the June 22, 2005 age-class and species table, and buffers primary roads, pipelines, railways and hydro corridors by 200 m but not secondary or tertiary roads.
sections.gapNote: The 2005 method is the default in oldForest.ts, with corridors from DRA primary roads, Crown rights-of-way and Energy Regulator permits; 2004 on request.

sections.bearsOn: For the patch objective, cutblocks are to keep wildlife tree retention and leave areas, and openings over 500 ha need more and larger (>10 ha) retention areas.
sections.gapNote: No rule flags a block or merged opening over 500 ha that lacks retention patches over 10 ha. Policy, not binding, but it is a per-opening test the planner could make from drawn retention.
proposedFacts: Is the opening, with any adjacent cutblocks it merges with, larger than 500 ha?
Does the opening keep wildlife tree retention or leave areas larger than 10 ha?

sections.bearsOn: Table 7 will not be met short to mid term in some units, and where other issues prevent trending toward it a rationale goes to the FSP decision maker.
Gives the five-stage buffer, merge and de-buffer method (75/100/200/300/400 m) that turns young openings into patches for Table 7.
sections.gapNote: patchMergeStages in the order JSON and spatial/patch-analysis.json (pg-2005-buffer-v1).

sections.bearsOn: Licensees and BCTS apportion the old growth objectives among their operating areas by MOU and report under a July 2005 protocol.
sections.gapNote: The planner reports unit totals, not a licensee's apportioned share; a reviewer could enter the share.

sections.bearsOn: Assigns plan preparation to licensees, endorsement to MSRM and approval and enforcement to MOF.
Sets periodic review with timber supply reviews and asks licensees to strive for a representative pine/non-pine portion of interior old forest, benchmark to be calculated.
sections.gapNote: The interior non-pine share is shown in the D.3 summary without a target, as the policy gives none.
